issues.issue: The four kinship terms name female relatives; regină denotes a role, not a family relationship. Coroană has ordinary royal, botanical and dental senses, supporting king/queen/tooth/tree. Household towel, mop, dish sponge and toilet paper absorb water in their stated normal forms; the group does not imply metal scourers absorb or trees are household objects. WMO supports liquid/solid atmospheric water as the common composition of rain, cloud, hail and fog. The label deliberately does not call all four precipitation. Everyday lexical and household/weather signals support broad recognition; no specialist interpretation or alternate full partition was found.
